items.title: Huntington Ingalls (NYSE:HII) Reports Upbeat Q2 CY2026, Stock Jumps 12.3%
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company Huntington Ingalls (NYSE:HII) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.9% year on year to $3.42 billion. Its GAAP profit of $5.27 per share was 37.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
